analysis: The trial executed successfully but achieved macro validation HR@10 of 0.3825, below the supplied 0.505 baseline by 0.1225. Category HR@10 was 0.430 for Movies_and_TV, 0.385 for Industrial_and_Scientific, 0.310 for Electronics, and 0.405 for CDs_and_Vinyl. These results do not support replacing SASRec with this candidate-conditioned similarity architecture under the tested training setup. Possible causes include limited explicit sequence modeling, separate history and target embedding spaces, and training on only one target per sampled prefix; the reported results cannot isolate their contributions. Exact agreement between the script's internal validation sampling and the pinned host evaluator is unverified. Allocated GPU time was 330.90 seconds.
code_summary: Trained one independent ItemAttention network per category and routed inference to exactly one selected checkpoint. Each candidate queries normalized history embeddings through learned query/key projections. Attention includes a jointly learned recency penalty; its weighted history context is normalized and scored against the candidate embedding using a learned scale and item bias. Training uses random training-only prefixes, 127 uniform negatives excluding observed training items, cross-entropy, dropout, AdamW, and gradient clipping. Checkpoints are selected by validation HR@10 with NDCG@10 as a tie-breaker. The predictor writer loads the matching architecture and category checkpoint. No ensemble or separately fitted scoring component is used.
